evidence: Modifies `test/functional/p2p_blocksonly.py` to fix the assertion checking that transactions are not announced to block-relay-only peers.
rationale: Fixes a vacuous assertion in `p2p_blocksonly.py` that passed regardless of whether transactions were announced to block-relay-only peers. Because the peer negotiates wtxidrelay and the test transaction has witness data, announcements use the wtxid; checking txid meant the test could not catch unintended transaction announcements.
